## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.
Link the work package or issue and name the affected files.
Explain any interface or scope decision.

## Evidence

Record the tested commit, environment, commands, and results.
Link GitHub Actions logs or attach logs with private data removed.
For visible changes, attach screenshots and explain what they prove.

## Review

- [ ] I reviewed duplicate behavior and sources of truth.
- [ ] I reviewed code complexity and maintenance cost.
- [ ] Tests cover useful behavior and important failures, or I explain why tests do not apply.
- [ ] User documentation describes current behavior.
- [ ] Commits form logical changes with short subjects and explanatory bodies.

## Limits

State gaps in the evidence and any open decisions.
Describe failures or untested paths that affect the result.
Delete this section if no limits apply.
